svg.title: Sending project data to the PM system on a change
svg.desc: When a budget transfer is approved, the budget module raises an event. The projects module rebuilds the 12 items, compares the hash and creates a delivery. If the PM system is down the item waits and retries. When the system accepts it, the state becomes sent.
